title: Gifts for Him Under $50 (He'll Actually Use)
desc: Useful, thoughtful gifts for him under $50: boyfriend, husband, dad and brother gift ideas for the griller, the gadget guy and the guy who has everything.
lede: Useful gifts for the boyfriend, husband, dad or brother who says he doesn't want anything. Every pick here is usually under $50.
card: Grilling, tech, everyday carry and cozy picks for the guy who says he doesn't want anything.

sections.name: For the grill guy
sections.note: Practical upgrades he'll use every weekend.

items.name: Instant-read meat thermometer
items.why: Reads in about 2 to 3 seconds, so no more cutting into the steak to check. The most-used gift a griller can get, and it costs less than dinner out.

items.name: Heavy-duty BBQ tool set
items.search: heavy duty stainless steel BBQ grill tool set with case
items.why: Stainless spatula, tongs and fork in a carry case. Looks great unwrapped and replaces the mismatched tools he's been using for years.

items.name: Wireless meat probe (budget pick)
items.why: Leave it in the meat and check the temperature from his phone. Feels like a splurge gift without the splurge price.

sections.name: For his everyday carry
sections.note: Small things he'll use every single day.

items.name: Slim RFID leather wallet
items.search: RUNBOX slim RFID leather bifold wallet men
items.why: Trades the overstuffed wallet for something slim that still holds cards and cash. A classic gift that never misses.

items.name: Ratchet leather belt
items.search: mens leather ratchet belt no holes
items.why: No holes, so it adjusts to a perfect fit. Clean buckle that works with jeans or a suit.

items.name: Magnetic tool wristband
items.search: magnetic wristband for holding screws tools
items.why: Holds screws, nails and bits on his wrist while he works. Weirdly fun to give, and every DIY guy ends up using it.

sections.name: For the tech guy
sections.note: Gadgets that feel more expensive than they are.

items.name: Wood phone docking station
items.search: wood phone docking station nightstand organizer men
items.why: Keeps his phone, keys, wallet and watch in one place on the nightstand. Looks handsome and can be personalized.

items.name: Solar power bank
items.why: Rugged backup battery for hikes, camping, travel or game day. One of those gifts he won't think about until it saves him.

items.name: Over-ear headphones
items.why: Comfortable wired headphones from a trusted audio brand, great for gaming, music or the office.

sections.name: For the guy who needs to relax

items.name: Shiatsu neck and back massager
items.search: shiatsu neck back massager pillow with heat
items.why: Heated massage pillow for his neck or lower back after work or the gym. Usually a hit with dads too.

items.name: Beard balm
items.why: Softens and tames the beard without feeling greasy. An easy add-on or stocking stuffer.

items.name: Moon lamp
items.why: A glowing, realistic moon for his desk or nightstand. Looks cool in a dorm, office or game room.
